reviews.x: This polish remover is awesome!  Not only does it take my nail polish strips off in almost no time at all, but it's also gentle on my nails.  The pump top dispenser and pleasant aroma are added bonuses.  Plant Therapy has provided yet another quality product.
Smells good, and not much chemical smell, the problem is it doesn’t work well. Can not remove , needs more amount and longer time. Won’t but again.

reviews.t: Was excited for this product. Instant disappointment
reviews.x: Was excited for this product to have a new alternative to chemical filled nail polish remover. Was extremely disappointed when I opened the package and the product was leaking everywhere. The bottle is soaked and gets everywhere any time I move or touch the bottle. Typically I wouldn’t write a negative review over something like this however there is no way to receive a refund or replacement for this product due to its return policy so that’s money completely wasted. Just wanted to warn someone

reviews.t: It wasn’t that strong of a remover
reviews.x: I did not think this was such a great nail polish remover. The one thing that is fabulous on it is the bottle so I may be reusing that with a stronger nail polish remover

I love Plant Therapy and was so excited to see they had released a more natural Nail Polish Remover. First off it smells amazing! The dispenser is interesting, but I love how it prevents accidental spills. I haven't had a chance to see how well it removes the polish, but will update when I do.

reviews.t: Not “natural,” works great, doesn't damage my nails
reviews.x: This Plant Therapy Natural Acetone Free Nail Polish Remover has a strong scent that fades. It works quickly and well on Sally Hansen regular, non-gel nail polish (the only one I’ve tested it with so far). For the record, I have wimpy, prone to peel and/or snap off, pathetically weak fingernails that get worse when I use acetone on them. This remover was surprisingly good, although I don’t think it’s natural at all.  PROS: • It took off three layers in a matter of seconds and left what seemed to

This product removed Ella+Mila First Kiss nail treatment (7 layers) with no problem.  It worked much better than any other non-acetone products I’ve used.  Haven’t tried it with regular polish yet but will update if results are less than my first experience.  Left my nails looking hydrated and smooth, not dry and parched like acetone.
This is a great product! I love the no-spill bottle and the solution quickly removed the old polish from my nails! Very pleased!

reviews.t: It works, butits oily the smell is...
reviews.x: It arrived quickly, slightly leaky. Works as nail polish remover but the stench... It's like a bad, cheap floral-ish smell wrapped in a really caustic chemical smell. It also leaves my hands and everything I touch slightly oily. I can barely stand it, won't return it because it a removes polish, but will never buy or recommend again. EDIT: I've only used about 2/3 of the bottle and I'm trashing it, I just cant with this stuff.
The contents all spilled out of the bottle all over all my mail. Nothing left in bottle to even attempt to try to use.
I only used it once and it took off all my polish.  Wasn't oily either if you don't like that type of remover.
Bottle was delivered spilled in box. There is no option to return the product.
Great product! Super gentle yet very effective.

I've used many different brands of nail polish removers in my lifetime, ranging from acetone, to non-acetone, to soy-based, to mineral. This, by far, is the WORST one I've ever used. Here are the pros: the bottle is great. The non spill bottle is convenient and will prevent nasty tip overs that could prevent damage to floors or furniture. This also doesn't have a chemical smell that other polish removers tend to have. Here are the cons: This doesn't remove polish! I tried this on my Color Street

reviews.t: Smells like Hawaiian Punch 😋 Great formula and I love the no-spill pump bottle!
reviews.x: This non-acetone polish remover from Plant Therapy smells so good! To me, it smells a lot like fruit punch (Hawaiian Punch, to be exact). You can smell it from the outside of the bottle as soon as it arrives. But don't smell it straight from the bottle, or on your cotton round... the solvents themselves have a very strong odor! After you use the product though, the only thing lingering is the fruit punch scent on your fingertips. There is a little bit of an oily residue left behind, but it beats

This is the most nourishing nail polish remover I've ever used. It hydrates my cuticles and makes my nails look shiny. The only bad thing is that it doesn't remove nail polish easily. I had to put a lot of pressure on and go over a nail multiple times to be able to remove the nail polish. Let's put it this way, if I was wiping my nails with a regular acetone it would have taken me couple swipes, but with this nail polish remover it took 15 swipes. reviews.t: Effective, nice scent, great touch dispenser bottle
reviews.x: When I think about nail polish remover, the first thing that comes to my mind is the strong not-so-pleasant acetone scent. However, this nail polish has removed that association. It has a sweet smell that is not strong and somehow pleasant. I had no issues while removing purple nail polish from my toes. It did not tinted my skin like other acetone based nail polish removers. It also left my toes a little oily, which is also something totally different to what I am used to after removing nail pol

Bottom line - this nail polish does what it’s supposed to do, I just don’t love it as much as I was hoping I would. The first reason for this is that it’s oily - it leaked during shipping, so about a quarter of the shipping box was soaked in oil. Of course, since it leaked it’s all over the bottle, and since it’s oil, it’s not terribly fun to clean up. Even if it didn’t leak, I don’t love the oiliness. It definitely sticks around on your hands when you use it. The second reason is the smell - as

I was a little leary buying this as some reviews said it didn’t remove polish well, but I find it works GREAT! I’m using a natural vegan polish so I wanted a natural polish non-acetone remover and this will be my only polish remover from now on.  AND I love the push down top dispenser, it’s so easy and less messy or wasteful than other bottles, I really like the convenience of it.  And, it works fast and completely removes my clear polish.  I don’t use color on my finger nails, I’m trying to hea

I can't stand the smell of normal nail polish remover so I don't paint my nails a lot. But my daughter does. She gave this a try said she liked it. It wasn't any different than regular polish remover. It just has a lighter more floral scent. I think it's an interesting design. You push down on the bottle topper and the liquid comes out. Just be careful that you don't push down for to long or you'll spill out. Oops. I also like that there aren't to many ingredients. My biggest test is the smell.

This is a simple to use nail polish remover.  I did not need to flip it, just pop the lid and press as shown in the ad.  I was able to remove standard polish (that is all I tried it on) in super quick time and it didn't stink up my area with harsh chemical scent.  No leaks when it arrived and small amount works for most polish (I had several layers on my toes that it got off) removal.  Priced reasonably well and this didn't dry out my nails at all.

I honestly expected this to take a lot of elbow grease to remove polish, but it was SO quick and easy. It smells great. Only negative is that it leaves your fingers very oily, but they need to be washed afterward anyway, so it doesn’t really matter. Love the pump top, it’s so convenient.

reviews.t: is toxic and not the least bit healthy for your nails or skin
reviews.x: Hated the smell and saw the ingredients that are very harmful for your health. It leaked in the shipping processs and the smell was unbearable, never tried for those reasons. I had to give it a rating, so I gave it one star, otherwise I would have not given any.

I didn't like this natural nail polish. It took much more scrubbing and nail pads to remove my nail polish. I also did not like the smell. My nails and nail beds felt very greasy after using this. I liked the dispenser, but I would not get this again.

I was a bit skeptical at first but, this product is great. Not only was the nail polish remover gentle on my nails and skin; it also removed the nail polish I was wearing with minimal effort. I would definitely recommend this product.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it removes nail polish quickly and effectively, including on multiple layers and non-gel polish.
Several reviewers praise the no-spill pump bottle and dispenser design.
A number of reviewers report the product arrived leaking or spilled, sometimes leaving the bottle empty.
Opinions on the scent are mixed, with some loving the fruity smell and others finding it strong or unpleasant.
Some reviewers find it too weak or ineffective as a remover, needing more product or longer time.
